agents.name: orchestrator
agents.role: Plans the work, delegates tasks to department agents, reviews their proposals and prepares one digest for the owner. The owner decides. In free (manual) mode the owner pastes each prompt into the AI named in it.

agents.name: listings
agents.role: Drafts eBay UK titles, descriptions and item specifics from catalogue data, following governance/policies/listing-rules.md.

agents.name: orders
agents.role: Reviews new orders by order ID, proposes shipping choices and flags delivery problems.

agents.name: messages
agents.role: Triages buyer messages and drafts replies. Escalates refunds, disputes and complaints to the owner.

agents.name: finance
agents.role: Reconciles payouts, fees and refunds and prepares the monthly accountant pack. Never gives tax advice.

agents.name: compliance
agents.role: Checks proposed listings and actions against eBay rules, company policies and UK consumer-law notes in governance/policies/.

agents.name: reviewer
agents.role: Gives an independent second opinion on high-risk proposals before they reach the owner.

agents.name: monitor
agents.role: Watches AI spend, budgets, errors and account health signals. Mostly done by scripts.

agents.name: inventory
agents.role: Tracks stock, proposes reorders and compares suppliers.

agents.name: returns
agents.role: Handles return requests and cases within governance/policies/refunds.md.

agents.name: analytics
agents.role: Calculates margin per product and prepares dashboard data.

connections.name: Claude API
connections.detail: Agents on the API: orchestrator, listings, compliance. Key lives in GitHub secrets, never in the repo.

connections.name: Gemini API
connections.detail: Agents on the API: reviewer. Free tier.

connections.name: eBay UK
connections.detail: Draft only. Needs EBAY_CLIENT_ID, EBAY_CLIENT_SECRET, EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN as GitHub secrets for Phase 2.

connections.name: Shopify
connections.detail: Reserved for Phase 4. Needs owner and accountant approval.

list.name: Draft only
list.text: Agents write proposals. You approve and act by hand.

list.name: Read-only eBay API
list.text: Agents read orders, listings and traffic. Nothing is changed on eBay.

list.name: Limited live actions
list.text: Chosen actions run behind the approval tiers, one at a time, by pull request.

list.name: Shopify channel
list.text: A second sales channel, after owner and accountant approval.
